# Techdr Medical Tourism
# https://medicaltoursindia.com

> Techdr Medical Tourism is a Hyderabad-based medical tourism facilitator with MOUs with 200+ hospitals across India. We help international patients access accredited treatment, medical visas, travel, interpreters, and transparent packages.

Contact: +91 6303225006 (Call / WhatsApp)
Email: info@medicaltoursindia.com
HQ: Hyderabad, Telangana, India

## What we help with

Heart surgery, knee/hip replacement, spine surgery, kidney/liver transplant, cancer treatment, hematology & bone marrow transplant (leukemia, lymphoma, thalassemia, sickle cell, CAR-T), IVF, cosmetic & plastic surgery (rhinoplasty, liposuction, mommy makeover, hair transplant), dermatology & skin care (vitiligo, psoriasis, acne scars, laser, melasma), bariatric surgery, dental implants, neurosurgery, cochlear implants, eye surgery (LASIK/cataract).
